special_rules: Saudi nationals and GCC nationals: no personal capital gains tax
Foreign individuals: 20% CIT on gains from Saudi-sourced income
Saudi-listed stocks: WHT of 5% on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders
Non-resident foreign investors in Tadawul: exempt from CIT on capital gains from listed securities (FINI exemption under Investment Tax Authority rules)
Zakat applies to Saudi/GCC shareholder equity at 2.5% of Zakat base (not CGT)
stock.filing_requirement: Zakat/Tax return with ZATCA (General Authority of Zakat and Tax)

special_rules: Saudi Arabia does not have formal crypto tax legislation as of 2026
SAMA (Saudi Central Bank) does not recognise crypto as legal tender
Crypto trading may be considered taxable income under general CIT rules for residents
No specific crypto CGT rules — this area is evolving rapidly
Seek specialist advice before any significant crypto transactions
Real Estate Transaction Tax (RETT): 5% on the transaction value (replaces VAT on real estate since 2020)
RETT is paid by the buyer, not the seller
Certain exemptions: first home purchase (up to SAR 1m), inheritance, gifts to first-degree relatives
No personal CGT on property gains for Saudi nationals
Foreign nationals investing in property: specific zoning rules apply; some areas restricted
real_estate.filing_requirement: RETT declaration with ZATCA within 30 days of transaction

notes: Saudi Arabia has no personal income tax. Zakat applies to Saudi/GCC company shareholders. Foreign company branches subject to 20% CIT. VAT at 15% on commercial transactions.
